description: This stacked bar chart from the paper "Context-Informed Grounding Supervision" illustrates the average attention rate at which a model focuses on three distinct input segments—context, generated response, and other (e.g., system prompts)—during the generation process, comparing two models: "Ours" and "Standard". The horizontal axis presents the two model categories, "Ours" positioned above "Standard". The vertical axis represents the attention rate as a percentage, with the bars stacked to show the proportional contribution of each segment. For the "Ours" model, the blue "Context" segment occupies the largest portion at 60.6%, followed by the orange "Generated Response" at 31.7%, and the green "Other" at 7.7%. In contrast, for the "Standard" model, the orange "Generated Response" segment is dominant at 51.1%, with the blue "Context" segment at 23.6% and the green "Other" at 25.3%. The bars are not sorted and are presented in a fixed order, with no visual emphasis or annotation beyond the percentage labels embedded within each colored segment.
